themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violations have exploded to 8 complaints this week alone, a 611% spike versus the 1.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.47), suggesting a sudden and dramatic shift in park usage or enforcement patterns on the Upper West Side.
evidence: 8 park rule violation complaints this week vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 11.47 indicates extremely rare statistical event
reporting_angles: What specific park rules are being violated and in which parks (Central Park, Riverside Park)?
Has there been a change in park enforcement, new events, or seasonal usage patterns driving the spike?

themes_detail.label: Derelict & Abandoned Vehicles
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints jumped 460% to 7 this week versus a 1.2 weekly baseline, while abandoned vehicle reports rose 129% to 12 last week versus 5.2 average, signaling a concentrated surge in vehicle abandonment and decay across the district this week and last.
evidence: 7 derelict vehicle complaints this week vs. 1.2 weekly average (460% spike, z-score: 4.43)
12 abandoned vehicle complaints last week vs. 5.2 weekly average (129% spike, z-score: 4.12)
Two-week window shows sustained vehicle abandonment problem
reporting_angles: Are specific neighborhoods or blocks experiencing clustering of abandoned vehicles?
Is this tied to parking enforcement changes, towing backlogs, or economic displacement?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Parking Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal parking complaints reached 174 this week, up 51% from the 115.2 weekly average over 8 weeks, marking a statistically significant (z-score: 4.53) escalation in parking violations across the Upper West Side this week.
evidence: 174 illegal parking complaints this week vs. 115.2 weekly average (51% increase, z-score: 4.53)
Illegal parking remains top 2 complaint category overall (1,743 over 90 days)
Spike concentrated in single week, suggesting acute trigger
reporting_angles: Has there been a change in parking meter enforcement, suspension of regulations, or event parking demand?
Are residents frustrated with lack of enforcement despite high complaint volume?

themes_detail.label: Street Obstructions & Tree Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints spiked 135% to 10 complaints 2 weeks ago versus 4.2 weekly average, while overgrown tree and branch complaints jumped 344% to 5 this week versus 1.1 average, indicating emerging sidewalk and street blockages across the district.
evidence: 10 obstruction complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.2 weekly average (135% spike, z-score: 5.28)
5 overgrown tree/branch complaints this week vs. 1.1 weekly average (344% spike, z-score: 4.18)
Converging trend suggests season-driven or maintenance-gap issue
reporting_angles: Are Parks Department tree maintenance crews falling behind, or is unusual growth occurring?
Are street obstructions related to construction, vendor encroachment, or deteriorating infrastructure?

themes_detail.label: Outside Building Violations
themes_detail.summary: Outside building complaints surged 700% to 4 last week versus a 0.5 weekly baseline, a rare statistical event (z-score: 7.0), suggesting a sudden uptick in code violations on building exteriors or facades across the Upper West Side.
evidence: 4 outside building complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 7.0)
Very low baseline makes spike highly anomalous
Category lacks clarity—likely façade, cornice, or exterior safety issues
reporting_angles: What specific outside building violations are being reported (façade damage, cornice safety, graffiti)?
Is this tied to recent weather events, aging building stock, or deferred maintenance?
